prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1333; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss from the insured driver by phone. Insured reports a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. Other vehicle reportedly left the scene briefly, then returned. Insured states a passenger-side mirror and rear quarter panel were damaged. Claim file opened and coverage verification started.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney. Claimant describes neck pain and stiffness beginning shortly after the impact. Claimant states they did not seek emergency treatment at the scene but plans to see a physician. Explained the claims process and requested medical provider information and a signed authorization for records.

Entry 3: Obtained the police report. It notes a lane-change collision with minor damage, no citations issued at the scene, and a witness statement from a passenger in a nearby vehicle. Photos of both vehicles taken from the report match the insured's account of the point of contact. Liability appears to lean toward the other driver, pending statements.

Entry 4: Claimant provided treatment notes from a primary care visit. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain with recommendation for rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and a follow-up in two weeks. No imaging ordered at this time. Bodily injury evaluation placed on hold until treatment progress is documented.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Neck symptoms reported as improving but still present with turning the head. Claimant indicates they have returned to most daily activities. Reminded claimant to send updated medical records after the next visit. Reserve reviewed and file remains open pending final medical documentation and the other driver's statement.
